root=pathlib.Path.cwd()

campaign="udt_shared_readout_metric_constraint_campaign_2026-09-06"

 r=subprocess.run(["git",*args],capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=30)
 return r.stdout
paths=git("ls-tree","-r","--name-only",pin,"--",campaign).decode().splitlines()
assert len(paths)==442
for name in paths:
 assert (root/name).read_bytes()==git("show",pin+":"+name),name

hashes={}

 data=(root/name).read_bytes()

 hashes[name]=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
registry=(root/"CURRENT_SCIENTIFIC_PREMISES.tsv").read_bytes()
old=b"".join(x for x in registry.splitlines(keepends=True) if not x.startswith((b"G357\t",b"G358\t",b"G359\t",b"G360\t")))
assert old==git("show",pin+":CURRENT_SCIENTIFIC_PREMISES.tsv")
assert hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest()=="23096ecbbdace34bb9f3add2cc288c9c62edd264a096620955be04b0510a7429"
initial=json.loads((root/"udt_g357_g360_conditional_banking_2026-09-07/STARTUP_WORKSPACE.json").read_text())["status_tool_result"]["output"].splitlines()
before=[x for x in initial if x.startswith("?? ")]
status=git("-c","core.preloadIndex=false","--no-optional-locks","status","--short","--branch").decode()
after=[x for x in status.splitlines() if x.startswith("?? ") and not x.startswith("?? udt_g357_g360_conditional_banking_2026-09-07/")]
assert before==after
print(json.dumps(dict(result="PASS",source_pin=pin,campaign_files_byte_identical=len(paths),fixed_hashes=hashes,old_registry_sha256=hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest(),unrelated_untracked_entries=len(after),protected_payloads_read=False,backup_completeness="UNVERIFIED",pre_reboot_unsaved_state_disposition="UNVERIFIED",scratchdisk="unused; archive-dependent tasks only"),sort_keys=True))
